articles.headline: Hannah Hidalgo becomes all-time leading scorer for Notre Dame women's hoops
articles.description: Hannah Hidalgo had 22 points and nine steals as she became Notre Dame's all-time leading scorer during the 13th-ranked Fighting Irish's 78-64 win over No. 22 West Virginia at the Battle 4 Atlantis.

images.name: 260329 Hidalgo [1296x729]
images.caption: Notre Dame guard Hannah Hidalgo, who had 22 points and 11 rebounds in Sunday's loss to UConn, ranked third nationally with 25.3 points per game and became the first player in Division I with 200 steals in a season, finishing with 202.

images.name: Hannah Hidalgo becomes Notre Dame's all-time leading scorer with 3-pointer

articles.headline: Friday Night Lights,' 'Ted Lasso' top poll ranking 21st-century sports shows
articles.description: A Seton Hall poll crowns America's favorite modern fictional sports TV series.﻿

images.name: TV Show Rankings [1296x518]
images.caption: A Seton Hall Sports Poll found that Friday Night Lights edged Ted Lasso by one percentage point among Americans asked to name their favorite sports TV shows of the 21st century.

images.name: One Tree Hill [1333x2000]
images.caption: Starring Chad Michael Murray and James Lafferty, basketball and family drama shared the court during "One Tree Hill's" nine-season run.
images.credit: The WB/Fred Norris/Warner Bros./Courtesy Everett Collection

images.name: Cobra Kai [2100x1676]
images.caption: Ralph Macchio and William Zabka took their "Karate Kid" rivalry through six seasons of "Cobra Kai."

images.name: All American [2100x1439]
images.caption: "All American" premiered in 2018 with Daniel Ezra starring as Spencer James, a high school football standout navigating life between South Central Los Angeles and Beverly Hills.
images.credit: Jesse Giddings/The CW Network/Courtesy Everett Collection

images.name: A League of Their Own [2100x1400]
images.caption: "A League of Their Own" premiered on Prime Video in 2022 and followed women pursuing professional baseball in the 1940s.

images.name: Heated Rivalry [608x342]
images.caption: Heated Rivalry stars Connor Storrie and Hudson Williams were torchbearers at the Milan Olympics in February.

images.name: Fans flock to 'electric' One Tree Hill reunion basketball game
images.caption: On the 23rd anniversary of "One Tree Hill," Tory Cabrera joins Vibe Check to talk about the basketball heart of the show, the Michael Jordan of it all and her time in Wilmington at the cast reunion game.
